title: Easy baby hummus
summary: Smooth, mild hummus with no added salt: great on a spoon, and a simple way to introduce sesame.
texture: Thick and smooth, slightly lumpy is fine at 8 months. Serve on a pre-loaded spoon or spread thinly on a soft toast strip.
ingredients: 1 can (15 oz) no-salt-added chickpeas, drained and rinsed
steps: Put everything except the water in a blender or food processor.
Blend, adding water a tablespoon at a time, until smooth and creamy.
Taste and adjust: no salt needed for baby. Scoop out baby's portion, then season the rest for grown-ups if you like.
choking: Blend until no whole chickpeas or skins remain: whole chickpeas are a choking risk.
Spread thinly. Thick dollops of any sticky spread can be hard for babies to swallow.

allergens.name: Sesame
allergens.note: Tahini is made from sesame, one of the top 9 allergens. If sesame is new, offer a small amount on its own first and watch your baby for 2 hours.

storage: Fridge up to 3 days in a sealed container. Freeze in small portions up to 1 month; stir well after thawing.
tips: Spread on a strip of soft toast for a finger food (this adds wheat).
Stir a spoonful into pureed roasted red pepper or carrot for color.
